title: Design: No locations shows the empty state as in the design picture
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations, and you untick both on A/R Detail to compare the empty report with the design picture.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • The design picture "Cleared: No locations" (ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, click "Clear selection".
  2. Close the menu.
  3. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: no location is ticked.
  • Step 2: the menu closes. As in the picture: the chip reads "Location: No locations" with the pin icon and no blue fill, still in the filter row; the table area shows the column headings without a Location column, then the empty state in the middle under a grey circle with a magnifier; no rows and no Totals row (the picture also draws a Totals row of $0.00; Chris Ward ruled there is none and the picture will be corrected: see References from Design); the empty state reads, letter for letter, "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." and an outlined "Clear all filters" button.
  • Step 3: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped; the layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S5-R6a: “With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
  • S5-R9: “The chip is shown whenever the report's list (S5-R3) has two or more locations, and always while fewer than all are ticked, so the choice can always be undone.”
  • S8-R5: “While a report loads it shows the native table progress bar. When the filters leave no rows, it shows the native empty state: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button when a customer or vendor, Past due or Location is chosen; that button keeps the as-of date and returns the customer or vendor, Past due and Location to their defaults (every location ticked).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png: figure "Cleared: No locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • ""Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". S5-R6a, S5-R9." (caption of "Cleared: No locations")

Difference from the PRD (DD-03), closed: PRD version 5 said with no location ticked, "the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column" (S5-R6a); the design shows "Location: No locations" with a Totals row reading $0.00 and $0.00 under the headings, above the empty state. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 13): no Totals row, as the PRD says; the design picture will be corrected. This case follows the PRD (S5-R6a, unchanged in version 9). The held design-version case D-78 (C715560) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Design note (DR-03): the design shows with one name ticked the chip keeps its prefix: "Location: Staging Lethbri...", "Customer: 10 Trucking", "Customer: Andrews' Truck ...". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R6 / S5-R13 say the chip shows "the name" and the chips are "exactly as on Sales By Customer"; the design shows how (prefix kept, shortened with "..."). Cases now say what the picture shows.
